institution.name: StatML EPSRC Centre for Doctoral Training (Imperial College London and University of Oxford)

qualifications: First-class or strong upper second-class honours degree in mathematics, statistics, physics, computer science, engineering or a closely related subject
Successful applicants usually also have a master's or research experience
Most funded studentships are for home-fee students; a limited number of scholarships for overseas applicants
Self-funded applications are not accepted; part-time study possible
Imperial applicants use course code G1703.1
description_short: StatML, the EPSRC Centre for Doctoral Training run by Imperial College London and the University of Oxford, is a four-year, cohort-based PhD programme in statistics and machine learning offering only fully funded places. Applications for 2027 entry close 6 January 2027, 12:00 UK time.
